slides.title: Welcome
slides.transcript: [warmly] Hi there! <break time="0.5s" /> Welcome to Hisham Abu el-Ela's corner of the internet. <break time="0.6s" /> By day, I'm a wireless engineer. <break time="0.4s" /> And by night... <break time="0.3s" /> [playfully] a Gen-A-I and automation geek. <break time="0.6s" /> [warmly] So, feel free to look around. <break time="0.3s" /> Explore the articles, <break time="0.2s" /> or the cool projects I've been working on.
